## Fabric CU attribution
Read from the Capacity Metrics model by the cuscope harvester (outside Fabric). CU figures are CU-seconds; percentages are of the capacity's base budget.

parameters.name: Capacity
parameters.label: Capacity
parameters.query:
FabricCapacities_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, capacity_name, sku) by value = tolower(capacity_id)
| project value, label = strcat(capacity_name, ' (', sku, ')')

content.title: Summary for the time range
Smoothed utilisation: background and interactive (reconstructed) vs the app. The red line is the throttling threshold. Drag across the chart to set the explain window.
